notes.title: Decision Legacy Collection is Here!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]Decision Legacy Collection[/b]! This game brings together all four iconic entries of the classic Decision series, from the original zombie-infested streets to the medieval battlegrounds, delivering the intense combat, base building, and survival gameplay that captivated millions of flash gaming enthusiasts.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the fans who embraced the original games. Your support and enthusiasm has been instrumental in reviving these classics for both longtime followers and new players. Thank you for joining us in a trip down [strike]memory[/strike] zombie lane!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015510/Decision_Legacy_Collection/
